page.overview:
What is Adventure Plushtrap?

is an unlockable character of FNaF World.

Plushtrap has an almost identical appearance to his core series counterpart, but smaller and much glossier. A few holes around his arms and a big hole in the side of his body are noticeable. He also lacks an endoskeleton jaw, which his core series counterpart had.

Plushtrap is a neat character to use as he has attacks that rely on poisons and slowing down enemies. His sludge can lower the enemies' speed while Bad Pizza can do huge damage to all enemies as well as poisoning them. Toxic Bite is weaker than Bad Pizza but it is more quicker to attack than Bad Pizza that takes time.
